newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Direction on super in May budget - Canberra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Direction on super in May budget - Canberra.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday next year's May budget would reveal how the government would alter the retirement savings subsidy it inherited from its Labor predecessor.
"They (the opposition) will just have to wait until next year's budget to get a firmer indication of where we're going," Costello told parliament.
Costello said the government remained committed to boosting saving levels, but it might consider an alternative means of honouring the former Labor government's superannuation pledge.
"We have reserved the right in relation to superannuation policy, as I said in the budget speech, to deliver into savings or a like vehicle," he said.
The former government, ousted in the March 2 election, said last year it would pay an amount equal to three percent of employees' wages into their retirement savings.
The employees would have to contribute another three percent.
